desc:
👑 Found your own country and rule it your way in Manage A Country, the nation-building strategy game on ROBLOX! Start with a flag, a few settlers and an empty treasury, and build a world superpower.

❤️ JOIN THE GROUP AND LIKE THE GAME for free rewards! https://www.roblox.com/communities/364700616

🌍 Pick from 6 lands, each with its own playstyle, then choose your government, founding story and right-hand adviser

🏛️ Run your Command Center: make big calls on the Decision Desk and handle briefings from Military, Economy, Infrastructure, Cities and World

💰 Set taxes, grow your GDP, and watch your debt! Past 3× GDP, your economy crashes

⚔️ Face your biggest rival, sign trade deals and alliances, and survive the War Room when talks fail

🏙️ Build cities, airports, ports and railways, and grow from 20 settlers to millions

🎲 Roll your luck, climb the leaderboards, and 1V1 SUMMITS are coming soon!
